name: v8pp
listed_description: Header-only library to expose C++ classes and functions into V8 to use them in JavaScript code. [BOOST] [website](https://pmed.github.io/v8pp/)
reason: No numeric comparison and no speed claim anywhere reachable. v8pp is a binding layer over V8 (BSL-1.0, 967 stars, last master commit 2025-11-19), not an interpreter, and it makes no claim to beat any baseline. README.md and docs/{addons,config,context,convert,exceptions,index,plugins,utilities,wrapping}.md have no benchmark, faster or overhead statements; the test/ directory holds functional tests only (no bench or perf files, no timing code); issue search for benchmark/performance/overhead/slow returns one unrelated question (#31, arrays of structs). The website (pmed.github.io) is blocked by the egress proxy. Two web searches found no benchmark of v8pp against raw V8 API or other binding libraries; the only number found is a search snippet of a Chinese-language PuerTS article (cloud.tencent.com) that reports PuerTS static methods 50-90% faster and member methods 4-5x faster than v8pp, i.e. v8pp as the slower baseline, from a competing project's authors and not opened.
